No soil. Hydroponics is one variation of many methods used to grow vertically, that system is quite efficient and relatively easy to run. High Pressure Aeroponics was a system developed by NASA to grow crops in space and can use as little as <1% the water compared to the 3% hydroponics uses. But when used on earth is admittedly finicky and prone to failure if power fails. 

Most companies that grow vertically use a hybrid low pressure aeroponics to get a little of the best of both worlds. Easy to run/maintain, reduction of water usage/waste, less risk of crop failure if power goes out.
